responsibilities.description: Produces a per-region quarterly report: it counts hives, works out the share of hives flagged for varroa, counts treatments per product and adds up harvested honey in kilograms. Regions are sorted by name.
responsibilities.name: Compile quarterly regional beekeeping report

responsibilities.description: Turns a quarter input into a UTC date window and keeps only the treatments and harvests that fall inside it.
responsibilities.name: Determine quarter date window

responsibilities.description: Loads apiaries, hives, treatment products, treatments and harvests from the repositories. It also asks the hive service whether each hive is flagged, so it can build the report.
responsibilities.name: Gather report data from repositories
